Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 81. Category: form. God Forms.

Godly Power-Up
You have learned to seamlessly mix your ki with your
mechanical energy source, pushing your mechanisms
“Even further beyond!”
Increase your Power by 3
You deal an additional 2d8 to all damage
Increase your Movement Speed by 20 ft.
You gain an additional +1 to your AC
At the end of your turn, you lose 3 Stamina
